summary: P1?P4 Major; P5?P8 Minor. Four Major groups comprise two false extension assertions, the global inverse-regularity gap, and a core Banach model gap. No counterexample to the main differentiable-element theorem or Hopf?Rinow on G with its stated hypotheses.

problems.title: Individual smooth conjugations do not supply jointly smooth extension data
problems.source_location: pp8-9 Definitions5.1-5.2; p11 Remark5.8; p12 Definition5.9(b),Theorem5.10(a)
problems.assumptions: H=l2(C) real Hilbert,U_t(z_j)=exp(ijt)z_j,E law(t,x)(s,y)=(t+s,U_-s x+y); split smooth section/retraction; each fixed conjugation smooth; flat right-invariant local addition.
problems.check: All hypotheses verified analytically. Alpha_t(n)=U_-t n, n=(1/j) has coordinate derivatives(-i) not in l2; abelian kernel makes section changes irrelevant.
problems.result: Counterexample to Theorem5.10(a)'s required jointly smooth datum.
problems.counterevidence: Does not refute differentiable vectors or strong-metric completeness; this model has complete flat right-invariant metric.
problems.impact: Stated extension classification includes extensions that fail its defining data regularity.
problems.correction: Add joint smoothness hypothesis or weaken datum and re-prove atlas construction.
problems.repair_verification: Narrowing identified; complete weak-data classification not supplied.

independent_acceptance_check.result: Confirmed counterexample to Theorem 5.10(a), with all stated structural hypotheses checked.
independent_acceptance_check.source_locator: Exact v3 pp.8?12, Definitions 5.1?5.2, Definition 5.9 and Theorem 5.10(a).
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: G=R?ell?(C), as a real Hilbert manifold, with (t,x)(s,y)=(t+s,U_{-s}x+y), (U_t z)_j=e^{ijt}z_j. Each fixed right translation is a smooth affine bounded map; group operations are continuous. The kernel/quotient are smoothly split and the section (t,0) is smooth. The flat product local addition is right invariant and the indicated strong metric is complete.
independent_acceptance_check.decisive_check: Conjugation on N is alpha_t(n)=U_{-t}n. For every fixed t it is smooth in n, as required by the definition, but at n=(1/j) the t derivative would have all coordinates -i and is not in ell?. Thus the asserted joint C? smoothness fails. N is Abelian, so changing a section cannot alter this action.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence: This does not disprove the differentiable-element manifold theorem or the separate Hopf?Rinow result. Fixed-parameter conjugations really are smooth; the failure is the stronger joint conclusion.
independent_acceptance_check.repair_scope: Require a genuinely joint smooth action or an additional uniform regularity hypothesis, or weaken the smooth-extension conclusion. The example cannot be repaired merely by selecting another section.

independent_acceptance_check.result: Confirmed failure of descent for the given right-invariant local addition.
independent_acceptance_check.source_locator: v3 pp.14?15, Proposition 5.12 and the quotient-addition step in Theorem 5.11.
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: E=R?, N=R?{0}, p(a,b)=b. The smooth local addition tau(a,b;u,v)=(a+u,b+(1+u)v), on |u|<1/2 and |v|<1, is right invariant, has identity vertical derivative and respects the kernel/coset condition.
independent_acceptance_check.decisive_check: The inverse coordinates are u=A-a and v=(B-b)/(1+A-a). Tp(a,b;u,v)=(b,v), but p(tau)=b+(1+u)v varies with u even in an arbitrarily small domain. Hence no addition on the quotient can make the claimed diagram commute with this specified tau.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence: The flat standard addition does descend in the same example. Therefore no claim is made that the quotient admits no compatible local addition, or that every conclusion of Theorem 5.11 is false.
independent_acceptance_check.repair_scope: Strengthen the projectability condition or construct a different quotient-compatible addition and prove its properties; preservation of the submanifold alone is insufficient.

For a fixed k and right-invariant local addition, L_y(v)=Omega(y,tau_e(v)y), L_y^(-1)(w)=Omega(e,tau_y(w)y^(-1)), and R_y=tau_y?L_y?tau_e^(-1) provide a plausible local operator/jet estimate via joint continuity and finite covers of compact sets. independent_acceptance_scope.result: All eight existing Problems were independently checked against their definitions, hypotheses, proof use and scope. P1?P3 remain Major; P4 is corrected from Minor to Major because its unsupported uniform-jet inference is used by Lemmas 10.7?10.11 and the principal Banach-manifold/ILB construction. P5?P8 remain Minor with concrete local corrections and downstream counterevidence. The revised report distinguishes actual theorem counterexamples, defective constructions and proof gaps.
counterevidence_and_severity_basis: P1 gives a genuine counterexample to the asserted joint smoothness in Theorem 5.10(a) while satisfying the half-Lie, extension and local-addition assumptions.

P2 disproves descent of the specified local addition, not the existence of every compatible addition. P3 disproves a central inverse-translation identity, not the main differentiable-element conclusion.
P4 affects actual core completeness and chart arguments. A plausible fixed-k repair does not lower the severity of the printed core proof gap.
P5?P8 have explicitly bounded formula, convention and extension-splitting corrections; the report does not turn them into unsupported global nonexistence or Hopf?Rinow counterexamples.
